name: auto-chain
description: Milestone → wave → task autonomous execution for large multi-session work. Opus plans, GPT-6.1 Sol reviews (codex CLI via a common review runner), Claude workers implement in parallel, and a lean coordinator session per milestone integrates, verifies and hands off to the next milestone. Workers run in three tiers: Claude Agent subagents by default, headless one-shot runs for other CLIs and reviews, and side-pane sessions (via the tool-neutral agent-orchestrator in tools/) only for watched work, planners that outlive a handoff, and milestone handoffs. Per-project hooks via .claude/autonomous-chain.md.
